name: SWL World Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Held by the kick Ass order's Mean Man and Basic Killer across the whole of this record, successfully defended in a three-way on the promotion's earliest surviving card.

name: SWL United States Television Title
epitaph: Won by Night from a previously undefeated Manhunter with the Nightfall powerbomb on the promotion's earliest surviving card.

name: SWL World Brawler Title
epitaph: Created and first won by American Heartthrob on the promotion's earliest surviving card; changed hands to Night off-page, then to Chaos Bill at Sharp Turn, who retained it through a technicality after being knocked unconscious at the 1st Anniversary show.

name: SWL World Lightweight Title
epitaph: Defended by Prodigy at Sharp Turn against Mr. Mainevent, then billed held by Hyper Man before Gene Hoffman won it on an uncollected episode of Friday Night Raw, per the fed's own mid-1998 newsletter.

name: SWL World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Won by Mr. Justice from Insanity at Sharp Turn; billed held by Mass Destruction by mid-1998, per the fed's own newsletter, after Mass Destruction's own turn on the promotion at its Pay Per View, Warzone.

name: The Supremer Strap
epitaph: Held by Kraze across the whole of this record, retaining it through a restarted, disqualification-ending challenge from Anthony Mislan at Warzone.
